package store

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// Acquire hands back a raw *pgxpool.Conn. A checked-out connection answers arbitrary SQL
// exactly like the pool it was acquired from, so it must be covered the same way
// *pgxpool.Pool is.
func (q *Queries) Acquire(ctx context.Context) (*pgxpool.Conn, error) {
	return q.pool.Acquire(ctx)
}
